title: About Us | RoboRingo
description: RoboRingo is an AI-powered communications company delivering an AI communications platform and enterprise AI voice platform for modern business communication.
html:
AI communications for modern businesses.

RoboRingo brings calls, texts, WhatsApp, and customer context together so teams can manage conversations in one place.

Our mission

Give teams one AI-native workspace for customer conversations, with the context they need across channels. RoboRingo brings together work that often lives in separate phone systems and CRM tools.

Built for AI-assisted conversations

RoboRingo was designed around both AI agents and human teams. It can route a caller to AI, hand the conversation to a teammate, and connect the interaction to the tools the business already uses.
